# Afisha Daily

> > Afisha Daily is a Russian-language news and culture publication covering organizations, media, technology, travel, and lifestyle topics.

Afisha Daily (Афиша Daily) provides comprehensive coverage of news releases and articles about various organizations, companies, and media outlets. The site aggregates content from multiple sources including news agencies, tech publications, airlines, and e-commerce platforms, serving as a cultural and informational hub for Russian-speaking audiences.

## Key Topics

- Afisha Daily
- Russian media
- News organizations
- Media aggregation
- Organization coverage
- News releases
- Associated Press
- Technology news
- Airlines and travel
- E-commerce
- Cultural content
- News agencies
- Corporate updates
- International companies

## News Agencies & Media Organizations

- [Associated Press](https://daily.afisha.ru/organization/associated-press): Associated Press news agency coverage and releases on Afisha Daily
- [Advis.ru](https://daily.afisha.ru/organization/advisru): Advis.ru organization news and articles archive on Afisha Daily
- [3Dnews.ru](https://daily.afisha.ru/organization/3dnewsru): 3Dnews.ru tech news organization coverage on Afisha Daily

## Technology & E-commerce Companies

- [Alibaba](https://daily.afisha.ru/organization/alibaba): Alibaba company news and releases archive on Afisha Daily

## Travel & Airlines
